title: Fema / RBI | RBI Cuts CRR & SLR Exemption Period for Rural Co-operative Banks
description: Fema / RBIRBI amends CRR and SLR Directions for Rural Co-operative Banks, replacing September 30, 2026 with August 31, 2026 for specified deposit exemptions.The post RBI Cuts CRR & SLR Exemption Period for Rural Co-operative Banks appeared first on TaxGuru.
